assertions.description: AbortController.abort(reason) stores an arbitrary reason on signal.reason.
assertions.test: (() => { const c = new AbortController(); const marker = { probe: 'conformance' }; c.abort(marker); return c.signal.aborted && c.signal.reason === marker; })()

assertions.description: abort() with no argument defaults signal.reason to an "AbortError" DOMException.
assertions.test: (() => { const c = new AbortController(); c.abort(); const r = c.signal.reason; return r instanceof DOMException && r.name === 'AbortError'; })()

assertions.description: AbortSignal.timeout() aborts with a "TimeoutError" DOMException as the reason.
assertions.test: (async () => { const s = AbortSignal.timeout(10); await new Promise((r) => s.addEventListener('abort', r, { once: true })); return s.reason instanceof DOMException && s.reason.name === 'TimeoutError'; })()

assertions.description: Aborting while the fetch promise is still pending rejects that promise with the custom abort reason (the long-standing half of the contract).
assertions.test: (async () => { const c = new AbortController(); const p = fetch('/v153/fetch-api-forward-reason-from-abortcontroller-to-fetch-response/slow-body?chunks=4&delay=150', { signal: c.signal, cache: 'no-store' }); c.abort(new DOMException('conformance pre-response marker', 'TimeoutError')); try { await p; return false; } catch (e) { return !!(e && e.message && e.message.includes('conformance pre-response marker')); } })()

assertions.description: Aborting AFTER the response headers arrived rejects the pending response.text() with the custom abort reason instead of a generic AbortError. This is the core Chrome 153 fix — expected to FAIL on Chromium before 153 (which substitutes a generic AbortError) and to pass on Firefox and Chrome 153+.
assertions.test: (async () => { const c = new AbortController(); const res = await fetch('/v153/fetch-api-forward-reason-from-abortcontroller-to-fetch-response/slow-body?chunks=6&delay=200', { signal: c.signal, cache: 'no-store' }); const body = res.text(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 250)); c.abort(new DOMException('conformance post-response marker', 'TimeoutError')); try { await body; return false; } catch (e) { return !!(e && e.message && e.message.includes('conformance post-response marker')); } })()

assertions.description: A pending response.body reader.read() also rejects with the custom abort reason when the abort lands mid-stream. Expected to FAIL on Chromium before 153.
assertions.test: (async () => { const c = new AbortController(); const res = await fetch('/v153/fetch-api-forward-reason-from-abortcontroller-to-fetch-response/slow-body?chunks=6&delay=200', { signal: c.signal, cache: 'no-store' }); const reader = res.body.getReader(); await reader.read(); const pending = reader.read(); c.abort(new DOMException('conformance stream marker', 'TimeoutError')); try { await pending; return false; } catch (e) { return !!(e && e.message && e.message.includes('conformance stream marker')); } })()
